svg.title: Cell-Based Architecture
svg.desc: Cell-Based Architecture. Many isolated, identical cells behind a thin router contain the blast radius of any failure. Step 1, One stack for everyone: Everyone shares one stack. J's poison request and its retries crash every instance: 100% are hit. Step 2, Split into cells: Four identical cells share nothing. The router looks up each customer's cell and sends it there. Step 3, Failure stays in one cell: The poison request crashes only cell 2: 25% of customers. New versions go out one wave at a time. Step 4, Grow by adding cells: Full cells stay at their tested size: a fifth cell takes the new customers. The router stays tiny.

g.text: Everyone shares one stack. J's poison request and its retries crash every instance: 100% are hit.
Four identical cells share nothing. The router looks up each customer's cell and sends it there.
The poison request crashes only cell 2: 25% of customers. New versions go out one wave at a time.
Full cells stay at their tested size: a fifth cell takes the new customers. The router stays tiny.
one deployment reaches every customer at once
J's request crashes an instance; retries crash the rest
wave 2: the other three cells, once wave 1 looks healthy
